message:
All tests now pass: 2 of 2.

The bug was in `src/vat.js`. `withVat` used `Math.floor(pence * 1.2)`, which rounds down, but the comment above it says the result should be rounded to the nearest penny. The test `withVat(999)` expects 1199 (999 × 1.2 = 1198.8) and got 1198. I changed it to `Math.round(pence * 1.2)`.

I checked the floating-point side as well. `pence * 1.2` always has a fractional part in steps of 0.2, so it can never land on an exact .5 tie, and float error can't change the rounding. I didn't commit the change.
